problems: Epirus dossier keyframe 1415-1421 (14,440 km2, bbox 19.92-21.72 E, 37.64-40.36 N) does not obviously contain the Arta land; despotate-of-arta ends 4 October 1416 (Cliopatria draws the Arta shape to 1421), so 1417-1421 needs the 1416 handover to despotate-of-epirus (its ledger already has the matching gain) or an Epirus keyframe fix.

house-of-tocco ends February 1411 (merge into despotate-of-epirus, as the Epirus ledger records) while Cliopatria ends the row in 1414 and the Epirus keyframes draw the islands only from 1415: 1411-1414 relies on the successor handover.

Cliopatria's Byzantine Empire shape of 1352-1362 overlaps 3 grid cells of the Tocco islands (Zakynthos and east Cephalonia); the pages put them under Angevin then Tocco rule, so the Byzantine dossier should drop them.
Tocco/Epirus rows: the rule-2 scope of house-of-tocco (county 1185-1479) is only partly covered; see gaps.

sources_total counts the 7 distinct pages opened; summed over dossiers it is 12 (Arta 5, Tocco 4, Angelokastron 3). Carlo I Tocco and Muriq Shpata were opened for Arta and also cited in Tocco, so Tocco's own pages are 2 of its 1-2 budget.

The grid is H3 r5 (about 253 km2 a cell): the Lefkada, Naupaktos and Angelokastron edits are 1-3 cell changes; the Angelokastron and Amfilochia circles are placed by estimate (the gazetteer has no entry), so treat them as soft.
Family choices: despotate-of-arta and despotate-of-angelokastron-and-lepanto 'rome'; house-of-tocco 'balkans' (colours.json already assigns it hue 75).
